standard-club.name: Standard club
standard-club.description: A typical club setup with Admin, Board Member and Member roles.

roles.admin: Full system access, bypasses all permission checks
roles.boardmember: Elevated access: can manage members, groups, events and finances
roles.member: Basic read-only access to club resources

small-association.name: Small association
small-association.description: Minimal setup for small associations: Admin and Member roles only.

roles.member: Can view members and events, and vote in polls

makerspace.name: Makerspace
makerspace.description: Makerspace setup with Admin, Operator and Member roles.

roles.operator: Can manage inventory, events and member access, but not finances
roles.member: Can view resources, use inventory and take part
